issue.title: New semantic analyzer: unbound base class results in crash

labels.name: semantic-analyzer
labels.description: Problems that happen during semantic analysis

issue.body:
This test case fails with assertion failure (Must not defer during final iteration) when using the new semantic analyzer:

```
[case testNewAnalyzerCyclicWithUnboundTypeVar]
from typing import Generic

class C(Generic[D]):
    pass

D = D
[out]
...
```

body: Thanks for reporting! This looks pretty bad, also the same crash exists for `attrs`, see https://github.com/python/mypy/issues/7129#issuecomment-535992300
@jjlee at least is related to #6809. I'm taking a look at this cluster
@msullivan Both my example and the original case were fixed by this lovely PR: #8271 (07a20a6a), so I think this bug can be closed.  Thanks!

issue.title: Crash when overriding field as property/method on frozen derived class
issue.body:
I see this on python/mypy master (41b40aa4f) and Python 3.7.5.

Following on from #7535 (fixed recently by @msullivan), this triggers another crash (really just adding the `frozen=True` from my example on that bug report, though I also dropped the args to `field` since I realised I could):

```
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Base:
    foo: bool = field()

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Derived(Base):
    @property
    def foo(self):
        pass
```

issue.title: Mypy internal errors are not shown

repository.name: ale
repository.description: Check syntax in Vim/Neovim asynchronously and fix files, with Language Server Protocol (LSP) support

issue.body:
I'm writing a piece of test code, and I realized that type checking was not working properly, after running mypy on the CLI I got this error:

```
mypy_test.py:210: error: INTERNAL ERROR -- Please try using mypy master on Github:
https://mypy.rtfd.io/en/latest/common_issues.html#using-a-development-mypy-build
If this issue continues with mypy master, please report a bug at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues
version: 0.720
mypy_test.py:210: : note: please use --show-traceback to print a traceback when reporting a bug
```

It would be interesting to have this shown early own.
